Market note

Selling an online business in Germany

The largest e-commerce market in Europe, with the deepest buyer group and correspondingly higher expectations of documentation.

Channels

Marketplace share is high and competition within categories is intense. Businesses with an own brand and direct traffic are valued distinctly above resellers, more so than in smaller markets.

Structures

Share transactions with detailed warranty catalogues are standard. Buyers arrive with advisers earlier in the process than elsewhere, and the investigation phase tends to be longer and more formal.

Buyers

Strategic buyers, aggregators and professional investors alongside individual entrepreneurs. For businesses above a certain size, competition among funded buyers is genuine.

Practical

Documentation standards are high. A file that would pass in a smaller market is often sent back for completion, which makes preparation the deciding factor in how long a German process takes.

Listings

Businesses currently offered across Europe are published at the European marketplace (https://www.businessforsale.eu/online-business-for-sale).
